ResourceHeader.Description: GOES-8 Solar X-ray Sensor (SEM/XRS) science-quality Level 2 daily solar X-ray background and average irradiance product (bkd1d), provided as a full-period NetCDF file. XRS-A covers 0.05-0.4 nm and XRS-B covers 0.1-0.8 nm. The product contains daily background irradiances, daily mean irradiances, quality flags, and daily average coverage fractions for both channels. Science-quality irradiances are retrospectively reprocessed using updated calibration and are not reduced by the historical operational scaling factors of 0.85 (XRS-A) and 0.70 (XRS-B). Consult the NOAA GOES 8-15 XRS Science-Quality Data ReadMe for processing methods and caveats.

NumericalData.ProviderResourceName: NOAA Space Environment Monitor (SEM) Science-Quality Solar X-Ray Sensor (XRS) Data from GOES 1-15
NumericalData.Caveats: GOES-8 through GOES-15 XRS science-quality irradiances may be affected by energetic electron contamination. Unlike GOES-R XRS Science Level 2 1-minute irradiance products, these data have not been corrected for electron contamination.

Parameter.Name: Record start time
Parameter.Description: Record start time of each daily XRS Level 2 sample, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, neglecting leap seconds.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Daily Background Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Daily background solar X-ray irradiance for XRS-A (0.05-0.4 nm). The background is derived from one-minute average measurements using hourly means in three 8-hour blocks.
Parameter.Caveats: A systematic calibration discrepancy remains between GOES-8 through GOES-15 XRS-A (short channel) irradiances and GOES-R XRS-A irradiances. The GOES-16/GOES-15 XRS-A ratio is approximately 1.34; this comparison is not a universal per-satellite correction factor. Evidence suggests that GOES-R calibration is more accurate.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Daily Background Quality Flag
Parameter.Description: Quality flag for bkd1d_xrsa_flux: 0 indicates good data and 1 indicates no value.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Daily Background Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Daily background solar X-ray irradiance for XRS-B (0.1-0.8 nm). The background is derived from one-minute average measurements using hourly means in three 8-hour blocks.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Daily Background Quality Flag
Parameter.Description: Quality flag for bkd1d_xrsb_flux: 0 indicates good data and 1 indicates no value.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Daily Mean Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Daily average solar X-ray irradiance in the XRS-A band (0.05-0.4 nm).
Parameter.Caveats: A systematic calibration discrepancy remains between GOES-8 through GOES-15 XRS-A (short channel) irradiances and GOES-R XRS-A irradiances. The GOES-16/GOES-15 XRS-A ratio is approximately 1.34; this comparison is not a universal per-satellite correction factor. Evidence suggests that GOES-R calibration is more accurate.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Daily Average Coverage
Parameter.Description: Fraction of the day contributing to the XRS-A daily average irradiance, from 0 to 1.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Daily Average Quality Flag
Parameter.Description: Quality flag for avg1d_xrsa_flux: 0 indicates good data, 1 indicates minimum coverage not met, and 2 indicates no data.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Daily Mean Irradiance
Parameter.Description: Daily average solar X-ray irradiance in the XRS-B band (0.1-0.8 nm).

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Daily Average Coverage
Parameter.Description: Fraction of the day contributing to the XRS-B daily average irradiance, from 0 to 1.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Daily Average Quality Flag
Parameter.Description: Quality flag for avg1d_xrsb_flux: 0 indicates good data, 1 indicates minimum coverage not met, and 2 indicates no data.
